articles.title: US financial crimes bureau discloses ‘cybersecurity incident’
articles.content: The Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) disclosed on Tuesday that it's investigating a "cybersecurity incident." The bureau, which is part of the Treasury Department, said it's looking into an "incident that resulted in unauthorized access to a limited subset of its systems." It hasn't offered any information about the full scope or source of the […]
